candidates.reason: Window counting followed by DISTINCT preserves one row per hour, including the NULL group, with BIGINT counts.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips

candidates.reason: Aggregate by pickup timestamp first, then combine counts by the original hour expression. Casting the sum to BIGINT preserves the original COUNT type.
candidates.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, CAST(SUM(timestamp_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS timestamp_trips FROM trips GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime) AS timestamp_counts GROUP BY 1

candidates.reason: Filter before window counting, then collapse repeated route rows with DISTINCT. NULL route keys remain grouped together and duplicate trips remain counted.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7

candidates.reason: Filtered aggregation counts qualifying trips within each route; HAVING removes routes with no qualifying trips while retaining BIGINT counts and the original date predicate.
candidates.sql: SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0
